# M1 pre-registered predictions

**Status: FROZEN at git tag `m1`.** These are the scored predictions of SPEC claim C4 and the descriptive prediction of C5. They are generated by `model/m1.py` and `model/report_m1.py` from `results/m1_predictions.csv` and `results/m1_summary.json`; no number below is typed by hand. After tag `m1` the model may be fixed, but fixed outputs are reported as post-hoc beside these, which remain the scored ones. The RTL is not tuned to match them (SPEC §6, pre-registration rule).

- `m1_predictions.csv` sha256: `fd94f39a1a913ee63cb03e4a9cd256cc42e6ca0df9dd0c5383c50ac62e4bd362`
- model commit (at generation): `1f4fa477cd158bdaa73b8e1dc482c91441955dd7`, date 2026-10-17
- driver constants: measured on stub (`drv_chain` = 71 cycles per `mcuaccel_run`, `drv_patch` = 15 cycles per patched field; results/driver_overhead.json)
- bench_main window overhead: 120 cycles (identical in both builds)
- mnist_cnn: baseline 12,188,028 cycles (`cycles_median`; commit `aef9183`, 10 images x 3 runs); software-op profile commit `7da607d`, 2 images x 1 runs; x_align 0
- cifar_mobilenet: baseline 72,157,425 cycles (`cycles_median`; commit `44fd6a8`, 10 images x 3 runs); software-op profile commit `7da607d`, 2 images x 1 runs; x_align 0

## 2. Per-network totals at P = 8 (architecture os)

| model | commands | chains | sum STAMP | accel (chains) | software ops | driver | bench window | accel+driver (C4b) | predicted model_run | baseline | speedup |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| mnist_cnn | 3 | 3 | 18,496 | 18,508 | 433,242 | 228 | 120 | 18,736 | 452,098 | 12,188,028 | 27.0 |
| cifar_mobilenet | 14 | 2 | 135,672 | 135,704 | 62,756 | 172 | 120 | 135,876 | 198,752 | 72,157,425 | 363.1 |

accel (chains) = Σ over commands of (STAMP + lam + 1) + 2 per chain. C4(b) scores `accel+driver` = accel (chains) + driver against the measured accelerated `model_run` minus the measured software ops (software and window terms are measurements, not scored). driver = chains x drv_chain + patched fields x drv_patch.

Software fallback ops carried through from the profile build (cycles per inference; conv/fc ops are accelerated and excluded):

| model | op | kind | cycles |
|---|---|---|---|
| mnist_cnn | 0 | transpose | 23,333 |
| mnist_cnn | 2 | maxpool | 258,577 |
| mnist_cnn | 4 | maxpool | 127,400 |
| mnist_cnn | 5 | transpose | 23,933 |
| cifar_mobilenet | 13 | avgpool | 62,756 |

Patched descriptor fields per call (DESIGN §6.5): mnist_cnn: 1 at P=8; cifar_mobilenet: 2 at P=8. A patched field is X_ORIGIN of a command reading the network `input` and Y_BASE of a command writing `output`; a split command is patched per descriptor.

## 4. Predicted saturation width P* (SPEC C5)

P* = smallest P in {1, 2, 4, 8, 16} whose Σ STAMP (accelerator only) is within 10 % of its value at P = 16; 16 means not reached on this grid. `P* end-to-end` applies the same rule to the predicted `model_run` (including the software term) and is descriptive only.

| cifar_mobilenet | 16 | 16 | 5.188 | 2.873 | 1.717 | 1.208 | 1.000 |

## 6. Known model biases (written before m1; DESIGN §7.4, SPEC §6)

- PSETUP: the +1 cycle per pixel is hidden behind the requantizer where a layer is requant or credit bound; the model keeps the +1 (conservative). Over-prediction by command: mnist op_1 +3.4 % (P=8,16), cifar op_2 +3.0 % (P=8,16), cifar op_4 +3.0 % (P=16), cifar op_0 +1.9 % (P=16), cifar op_6 +1.3 % (P=16), all others < 0.5 %
- FLUSH: the real remainder after the last issue is NV + 10 cycles; the model's W_last + 2*lam + 10 + NV counts the last tile's W_t and NV in both T_tile and FLUSH and over-predicts by 2 + W_last cycles per command (<= P + 3; <= 7 at P=16)
- *_WAIT phases: +0 cycles if fetch idle is combinational as specified (DESIGN 8.4); a registered idle would add <= 4 cycles per command (0.6 % worst case, cifar op_15 at P=16)
- Driver: drv_chain = 71 was measured on the stub (first poll sees DONE); a real chain adds ~6-7 cycles of phase wait, +3 for call-site addressing, and the per-model_run-call bind check (~8-10 cycles) is not modelled: ~40 cycles under-prediction on mnist (0.2 %)
- STAMP is self-reported by the ctrl counter; M5/M6 assert per chain that CYCLES == sum(STAMP + lam + 1) + 2 and count at least three commands independently from a VCD
- (T1.2) C4(b) measurement side: the profile macros (MCUACCEL_PROF_END 64-bit accumulate, ~30-40 cycles per op), the call/return around each accelerated chain function and the model_run prologue land in the measured interval but not in c4b_pred_cycles: ~200-500 cycles under-prediction (~1-2 % on mnist, < 0.5 % on cifar)
- (T1.2) y_align = 0 is assumed (bench_main's s_out has no alignment attribute and is not extracted from the link map); a misaligned output costs <= 1 cycle per tile of the final fc
- (T1.2) software-op cycles: the profile build is 0.46 % faster than the uninstrumented cifar baseline on the same 2 images, so the compiled fallback code is not identical across builds; these cycles are measurements, not scored
- bus_rd counts NT * sum_pix R (x re-fetched per tile)
